QuestInfo.0: Witch Malady is in need of #bDark Tokens#k. Collect them and bring them to her.
QuestInfo.1: Witch Malady is in need of #bDark Tokens#k. Collect them and bring them to her.
QuestInfo.2: Witch Malady is in need of Dark Tokens. Collect them and bring them to her.

0.0: Hey, you there! According to my loyal spy, the bat, you picked up a #bDark Token#k. Is this true?

yes.0: To normal folks, the Dark Token is of no worth. But for me, it's near priceless! If you can get me the #bDark Tokens#k, I'll give you something that you can surely appreciate. When you are finished with the task, come see me. I am staying in many of the towns. Ha!

no.0: How dare you refuse a witch? You're either foolish or really brave. Ha! I'll let you go this time...
